evidence.observation: Pressure drifting monotonically upward during growth: 3.04 → 3.33 Torr from t=2520 to t=3240 at constant Ar 100 sccm and constant T, unlike the stable ~3.05 Torr earlier
Ar flow steady at setpoint (~100 sccm), so the pressure rise is not flow-driven
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/leak status cannot be verified as the growth stage requires
Temperature holds 750 °C with stable heater power ~46%; thermal control nominal

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 (not installed) to distinguish an air in-leak from partial exhaust restriction; a pump-down/flow-step test (e.g., Ar setpoint change or valve isolation with pressure rate-of-rise) would discriminate seal leak vs exhaust blockage.
